name: dsh-win-computer-use
description: Windows-first Computer Use plugin for DeepSeek Harness: deep Win32/WinUI/UIA engineering, zero-approval delivery escalation (background → foreground → bring_to_front, restoring focus), 23 tools with a dispatcher-first 2-tool surface, prompt-cache friendly.

permissions.summary: 通过宿主 spawn 以非 shell 固定 argv 调用 cua-driver 原生驱动本地桌面：屏幕观测（screen_observe/screen_zoom，AX 树+窗口快照）、虚拟鼠标键盘模拟（computer_click/type/set_value/key/scroll/drag/wait）、确定性验证与轮询（computer_verify/wait_for）、剪贴板（computer_clipboard）、菜单直调（computer_menu）、应用枚举/启动/窗口激活（app_list/app_launch/computer_activate）。安全姿态（无感自治）：动作零审批零打断；所有输入/指针类操作工具（click/type/set_value/key/scroll/drag）要求先 screen_observe 并绑定快照窗口，菜单/悬停/应用启动按各自参数定位；凭据硬保护（密码框拒绝自动输入）为唯一硬拒绝，Windows 以 UIA sidecar 结构位（IsPassword ∨ ES_PASSWORD）标记，启发式为降级路径；extremePatterns 命中仅附加警告注记不阻断；快照 TTL/无快照拒绝/作用域白名单兜底；虚拟光标不抢占真实鼠标；前台重试会短暂切换并恢复原前台。无文件读写；环境变量仅 CUA_DRIVER_BIN/CUA_SESSION 与可选的 ZHIPU_API_KEY/GLM_API_KEY/GLM_API_BASE/GLM_VISION_MODEL（GLM 视觉兜底）；核心无网络，GLM 兜底启用时经其官方端点外呼并发送截图。
commands: cua-driver (non-shell fixed argv, resolved via CUA_DRIVER_BIN or PATH)

powershell.exe (non-shell fixed argv, ships tools/uia-password-scan.ps1 — Windows structural password scan, read-only, passwordScan:'off' disables; tools/private-drag.ps1 — private SendInput drag helper for modifier drags only, foreground, no from_zoom; tools/native-dialog.ps1 — Win32 standard #32770 modal dialog scan and BM_CLICK, same-pid only, nativeDialogs:'off' disables; tools/native-menu.ps1 — classic Win32 HMENU resolve + PostMessage(WM_COMMAND), same-pid/exact path/leaf command only, nativeMenus:'off' disables; tools/native-button.ps1 — standard Win32/WinForms Button unique-match BM_CLICK, same-pid, nativeButtonTrigger:'off' disables; tools/background-input.ps1 — experimental plugin-side background input (B0 posted/control, B1 synthetic touch, B2 cursor anchor, B3 window anchor) plus PTC show (SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE), same-pid only, default off via backgroundInput/syntheticPointer/anchoredInput, no file/network; tools/uia-scroll.ps1 — PTC scroll via UIA ScrollPattern, fixed argv, same-pid/point check only, no file/network; Add-Type temp compile under user TEMP)
permissions.externalServices: none (core); optional GLM vision fallback to GLM_API_BASE (default bigmodel.cn) when ZHIPU_API_KEY/GLM_API_KEY is set; DeepSeek observer uses host llm
permissions.failureBoundaries: cua-driver 缺失 → 结构化错误含自救指引；守卫拒绝（凭据保护/白名单/快照缺失或过期）→ 明确拒绝原因；引擎拒绝 → ok:false 结构化回执；超时 → 超时错误
